data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 385.226m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 8.68m (gross) driven by adverse movements in some older years (notably 2014 and 2016) partially offset by releases in other years. The Managing Agent reports an improvement on a net basis (GBP 9.6m net) due to favourable developments across several classes (Cyber, Political Risks/Excess Casualty and Energy), although Marine exhibited adverse experience. Overall the gross picture is a modest strengthening (adverse) before reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 193.5m (2017: GBP 140.2m) is an improvement of GBP 9.6m (2017: deterioration of GBP 19.1m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments across the significant classes.
Despite some material losses from the US Catastrophes the overall impact has been modest and within our expectations for our unified business.

favourable experience across a number of classes most notably Cyber, Political Risks Excess Casualty and Energy was offset in part by the now discontinued Marine classes which incurred a combined claims ratio gross of acquisition costs of 110.5%.
There has been evidence of improving rates in some lines, but overall insurers' margins remained poor / inadequate in many lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year movement was not provided as a single gross figure in the movement note (the narrative provided a net figure). Therefore the gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative ultimates). There is some potential distortion risk from year-of-account reinsurance to close (RITC) activity referenced in the report (2016 year RITC), which can affect the triangle; this may affect precision. Net movements reported by management (net GBP 9.6m release) differ from the gross triangle-derived result (gross GBP 8.684m strengthening) indicating material reinsurance effects.
